description: Defines the class WeightedPermissions, a mutable collection managing granted and revoked WeightedPermission objects, with methods for adding permissions, retrieving highest-weight permissions, and internal data management.

classes.name: WeightedPermissions
classes.description: A mutable, unsorted collection of granted and revoked WeightedPermission objects, providing methods to add permissions, retrieve permissions with highest weight, and manage internal state.

methods.name: getAllGranted
methods.description: Returns the set of all granted permissions.

methods.name: getGrantedWithHighestWeight
methods.description: Returns a map of granted permissions with the highest weight for each specified permission.

methods.name: addGranted
methods.description: Adds a WeightedPermission to the granted set.

methods.name: addGranted
methods.description: Creates and adds a granted WeightedPermission with specified permission and weight.

methods.name: addGranted
methods.description: Adds multiple permissions with the same weight to the granted set.

methods.name: getAllRevoked
methods.description: Returns the set of all revoked permissions.

methods.name: getRevokedWithHighestWeight
methods.description: Returns a map of revoked permissions with the highest weight for each specified permission.

methods.name: addRevoked
methods.description: Adds a WeightedPermission to the revoked set.

methods.name: addRevoked
methods.description: Creates and adds a revoked WeightedPermission with specified permission and weight.

methods.name: addRevoked
methods.description: Adds multiple permissions with the same weight to the revoked set.
